_note: Human-editable taxonomy of the KINDS of alternative explanation that records weigh against their mainstream reading. Each archetype matches an alternative if any pattern hits its NAME (strong) or two patterns hit its text. Extend it when the report lists unassigned alternatives. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.

archetypes.label: A lost advanced civilization or unknown technology
archetypes.what_to_check: Positive, dated, in-context evidence of the technology itself, not an inability to explain the object.

archetypes.label: A non-human craft or intelligence
archetypes.what_to_check: Physical evidence or multi-sensor data that survives mundane explanations.

archetypes.label: Misidentification or a mundane cause
archetypes.what_to_check: Whether the reported effect is reproduced by an ordinary cause (sensor geometry, atmosphere, known aircraft).

archetypes.label: A natural formation rather than a human construction
archetypes.what_to_check: Tool marks, worked debris, or an occupation layer; otherwise geology explains the geometry.

archetypes.label: Contamination, intrusion or a dating artefact
archetypes.what_to_check: Independent dating of the same context, and stratigraphic integrity.

archetypes.label: A forgery, hoax or later invention
archetypes.what_to_check: Provenance and the earliest independent record of the object or claim.

archetypes.label: A symbolic, literary or non-literal reading
archetypes.what_to_check: The genre and the language of the earliest source before any literal reading.

archetypes.label: A memory of a real event
archetypes.what_to_check: An independently dated physical event of the right size and place, and a plausible transmission path.

archetypes.label: Contact, diffusion or outside influence
archetypes.what_to_check: Multiple independent lines (material, genetic, linguistic) for the contact, not a visual resemblance.

archetypes.label: Independent or local development
archetypes.what_to_check: Continuity of local material culture and absence of any outside marker.

archetypes.label: A different function or purpose
archetypes.what_to_check: Domestic or practical debris in sealed floors, and parallel structures of known use.

archetypes.label: A different (older or younger) date
archetypes.what_to_check: Direct dating of the object, a sealed stratigraphic position, and the method's known failure modes.

archetypes.label: A different population, lineage or species
archetypes.what_to_check: Ancient DNA or morphology that separates the proposed lineage from the standard model.

archetypes.label: Over-reading a pattern or selective matching
archetypes.what_to_check: A pre-registered test of the pattern against randomised alternatives.

archetypes.label: A different cause (climate, ecology or politics)
archetypes.what_to_check: Palaeoclimate or ecological records at the same resolution as the event.

archetypes.label: Doubt about authenticity, authorship or textual transmission
archetypes.what_to_check: Manuscript tradition, earliest attestation and linguistic dating.
